text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite a small decline in Period 3, so I should judge results over time rather than react to every monthly move.","Selling Stock E at a large gain felt rewarding, but I should not let that win—or my reluctance to admit a loss—decide whether to hold or sell; each position deserves an objective reassessment.","Because past price changes do not predict future ones, checking often and trading more is not an edge; I should make deliberate decisions and avoid unnecessary trades."]}
